own_current_understanding.splits_and_control: Training updates weights; validation compares recipes/candidates; final test assesses a fixed selected configuration. Correct transcripts sent to the same chat model check answering independently; true ASR transcripts check the full route. If the correct-text path already fails, recognition alone cannot explain it. A new version tuned on final errors needs a new unseen final test.

These are cited card counts and historical arithmetic, not a new scoring run.
